title: Licensing of Cat Breeders Since Implementation of Guidelines
what_it_is: Licensing of Cat Breeders Since Implementation of Guidelines

sections.label: Licensed commercial cat breeders
sections.summary: NParks has licensed three commercial cat breeders since licensing conditions were published in July 2023, and they rent units at The Animal Lodge.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Since the licensing conditions for commercial breeding of pet cats were published in July 2023, the National Parks Board (NParks) has licensed three commercial cat breeders.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: These cat breeders are currently renting units at The Animal Lodge.

sections.label: Illegal cat breeding investigations
sections.summary: Between January 2023 and August 2024, NParks investigated 58 illegal cat breeding cases, seized 91 cats, which remain under its care and veterinary assessment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Between January 2023 and August 2024, NParks investigated 58 cases of illegal cat breeding and seized 91 cats from these illegal breeders.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Tan Kiat How) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: These cats remain under the care of NParks and are regularly assessed by veterinarians.
